gloss: kimono sleeve; foot of a bridge

definitions.explanation: The long, hanging part of a kimono sleeve, which forms a pouch below the arm where small things can be carried.

definitions.gloss: foot of a bridge; side; vicinity
definitions.explanation: The area right beside something, above all the end of a bridge ({橋|はし}の{袂|たもと}); literary in other uses.

notes:
Outside kimono talk, the word lives mostly in set phrases.

- {袂|たもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{分|わ}かつ: to part company, to break with someone (literally, to separate sleeves)
